content: CRITICAL: Dexie.js cannot index null/undefined values — IndexedDB does not accept null as a valid key. where('deletedAt').equals(null) will NOT work. Likewise notEqual(null) excludes records with null deletedAt entirely (null is not in the index). Solution: use a sentinel approach — store '' (empty string) as the 'not deleted' value and an ISO timestamp string when deleted. OR: do not index deletedAt and use .toCollection().filter(m => m.deletedAt === null) for main list — full table scan but acceptable at 1000 records. Alternatively: boolean isDeleted index with 0/1 values, then where('isDeleted').equals(0). At 1000 records a toCollection().filter() is ~5ms and within perf budget.
